subscriptions.err_cancel_period.en: The last period an end-of-period cancel keeps must be a whole period number. Cancel the agreement at the end of its period again from its page.

subscriptions.err_generation_mode.en: Choose a billing mode: generate due by hand, or bill automatically.

subscriptions.err_auto_send.en: Send automatically is either on or off. Set it on the agreement's page.

subscriptions.err_schedule_removed.en: This agreement is on a schedule, so it keeps its first bill date. To stop billing it, pause or cancel it.
